Meet the Library

Riverside Public Library. Ana Torres has three books out.

BookRenewalsHold waitingWhat the loan offers nowWhy not renew
Matilda0norenew, report a problem, return
The Hobbit0yesreport a problem, return“A hold is waiting for this book, so it can’t be renewed.”
Charlotte’s Web3noreport a problem, return“It has been renewed 3 times, the most allowed.”

What a loan offers depends on its state. When something isn’t offered, the library says why.
say: Let's make that concrete, with an example we'll follow for the rest of the talk. Riverside Public Library. Ana Torres has three books out. Matilda can be renewed: it offers renew, report a problem, and return. The Hobbit can't be renewed, because someone has a hold waiting for it. Charlotte's Web can't either: it's been renewed three times, the most allowed. Notice two things. First, what each loan offers depends on its state, and the library says so in every answer: the form to renew is there, or it isn't. Second, when it isn't, the library says why, in plain words. That's exactly what a browser shows a person. It's also exactly what an agent needs. Keep this library in mind; it's going to get a new renewal policy, and that policy is going to go all the way to a Dev environment.
